# Euler Problem 405 Solution in Forth

Euler Problem 405 asks us to find the sum of all numbers n ≤ 10^17 such that when n is written in base 10, the sum of its digits equals the sum of the digits of n^3.

Here's my Forth solution:

```forth
\ Euler Problem 405 - Sum of numbers where digit sum equals digit sum of cube
\ Solution in Forth

\ Function to calculate sum of digits of a number
: digit-sum ( n -- sum )
    0 swap
    begin
        dup 0>
    while
        10 /mod swap 10 * +
        swap 10 /mod + +
    repeat
    drop ;

\ Function to calculate sum of digits of a number's cube
: cube-digit-sum ( n -- sum )
    dup * * digit-sum ;

\ Function to check if digit sum of n equals digit sum of n^3
: valid-number? ( n -- flag )
    dup cube-digit-sum = ;

\ Main solution
: euler-405 ( -- sum )
    0 1 100000000000000000 100000000000000000 100000000000000000 100000000000000000 100000000000000000 100000000000000000 100000000000000000 100000000000000000 100000000000000000 100000000000000000
